regime_context: China A-shares detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership (Banks and Innovative Pharma & CXO) with everything else ineligible or deeply negative, but the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (mean-reverting tape) and cross-sectional momentum has weak rank-IC. Macro narrative is coincident and unscheduled-surprise share is extreme (1.0), so no regime read offers an edge here.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Semiconductors (rank 8, eligible, trend tag, breadth 0.091) closes its durability gap toward Banks/Pharma — the condition to retire this watch is Semiconductors' durability_bar rising above 0.60 while remaining eligible, which would mark a confirmed third theme and widen the rotation.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the only eligible theme besides Banks with a sustained durability bar (0.60) and broad participation (breadth 0.643), and it is the challenger in a narrow rotation (margin 0.01). Its crowding is positive but below Banks; given the mean-reverting tape the detector's absolute-trend gate is display-only, so this is a structural-quality lean, not a momentum call.
evidence: rotation.challenger name Innovative Pharma & CXO, margin 0.01
theses.dissent: Chinese healthcare is policy-sensitive and a crowded (1.59) theme that has already run; on a whipsaw tape anything without a durable absolute trend can give back its relative gains quickly.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags CSI 300 by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the check date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the leader by every detector leg: highest score (0.998), highest durability (0.73), broadest breadth (0.889), and eligible. It is crowded (1.78) which is a size-down caution only, never a fade. Direction is supported by the coincidence of rank, trend-health, and participation, even though the trend gate itself is unvalidated on this market.
theses.dissent: Leading by momentum rank where rank-IC is ~0 means the lead may be a top, not a trend; high crowding plus a mean-reverting tape leaves Banks exposed to a sharp shake-out if the macro surprise flow turns.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS gives back half its trailing 20-day relative gain versus CSI 300 before the check date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is eligible but its durability is middling (0.46), breadth is thin (0.30), and hurst_tag is the only mean-revert tag in the ranks — the weakest trend-health signature. On a mean-reverting tape with no validated trend gate, an eligible but mean-revert theme is the one to avoid.
evidence: hurst_tag mean-revert (distinctly weaker trend-health than the two leaders)
theses.dissent: Avoid is still a judgment; Coal could catch a cyclical bid if policy narrative shifts, and its mean-revert tag says nothing about upcoming returns.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS breaks above its 40-day high relative to CSI 300 before the check date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
